Hence files are 0640 with group gid 1000, so the agent can read what it must read and write nothing. No parent mount may bypass a narrower one.

Every data/activity/<domain>/ folder is rw for exactly one service. guild-build has two subfolders, facts/ and update/, each rw for its one writer (S8); no service mounts guild-build/ itself.

Each service that calls the internal API has its own token file; the API maps token to allowed actors: agent → cos; cos-bot → telegram, cos; scheduler jobs → scheduler; portal → mc; supervisor → scheduler. A command whose actor is not allowed for its token is refused not_authorized (S4).
